title: Tourist Season, 2018 · the aggregator
venue: Arthur's site · the coastal weeklies · the aggregator
logline: Two days after: an email from the aggregator on the garage's screen, asking for the Sunday vertical and the signature bigger, and Wood reading it with the pup's chin on his knee, and the stick chorus — twelve years old now — climbing back out of the monitor for the first time since 2006. Wood switches it off. One stays on the desk.

panels.composition: The garage. WOOD at a laptop, the screen a gray rectangle. The PUP's chin on his knee.
